lanternPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-viewport background for inflation.gg, a MapleStory fan market dashboard. Create one single seamless-looking landscape composition (wide 16:9), not panels, no borders or letterboxing. Scene: a cozy lantern-lit forest market at blue-green dusk inside enormous old trees, winding wooden market platforms and rope bridges, moss, ferns, glowing fireflies, little potion stalls and coin pouches, a few tiny cheerful MapleStory-style adventurers trading and exploring. Beautiful finely detailed classic 2D pixel-art game scenery, readable silhouettes, rich forest greens and muted warm amber lantern light; calm, wholesome atmosphere to match a dark olive dashboard. Full-bleed detailed scenery all the way to every edge, no large empty black area. Composition: interesting forest/stalls visible in both left and right outer thirds, central woodland depth. No text, letters, numbers, UI, watermark or logos. Decorative fan illustration, not a screenshot.
